kebab_example: aliyun ens create-security-group --security-group-name Dcdn1:2_3-4 --description testDescription --permissions Policy=Accept PortRange=80/80 Description=testDescription SourcePortRange=22/22 Priority=1 SourceCidrIp=0.0.0.0/0 IpProtocol=TCP DestCidrIp=0.0.0.0/0 Ipv6SourceCidrIp=example-string Ipv6DestCidrIp=example-string Direction=ingress --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the security group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. By default, this parameter is empty
parameters.help_zh:
安全组名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
默认值：空
parameters.name: security_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the security group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
描述信息。
长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The description of the security group rule. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
描述信息。
长度为2~256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 目的端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The direction of the security group rule. Valid values:

egress: outbound

ingress: inbound
fields.help_zh:
授权方向。
egress：出方向。
ingress：入方向
fields.name: direction

fields.help_en:
The transport layer protocol. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

ICMP

ALL
fields.help_zh:
协议类型。取值范围： 
         
TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议。
ALL：支持所有协议
fields.name: ip_protocol

fields.help_en:
The policy of the security group rule. Valid values:

Accept: allows access.

Drop: denies access
fields.help_zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
Accept：接受访问。
Drop：拒绝访问
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en:
The range of the destination ports for the security group rule. Valid values:

If you set the IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. You must use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port, for example, 1/200.

If you set the IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

If you set the IpProtocol to ALL, the port range is -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 安全组规则优先级，数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The source IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
fields.help_zh: 源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The range of the source ports for the security group rule. Valid values:

If you set the IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. You must use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port, for example, 1/200.

If you set the IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

If you set the IpProtocol to ALL, the port range is -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en: The rules of the security group. Valid values of N: 0 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 安全组规则数组。数组长度：0~200
parameters.name: permissions

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the newly created security group
